headline: Flat quarter overshadowed by ICE deal and guidance pullback
summary_short: MarketAxess's Q2 FY2026 revenue was $218.4M, down 6.4% q/q and roughly flat y/y (-0.5%) as a 3% drop in commission revenue was offset by 14% growth in services revenue; diluted EPS of $1.93 rose 1.0% y/y ($1.95 excluding notable items) even as net income fell 4.3% y/y to $68.1M.
summary_long: Revenue of $218.4M was essentially flat y/y: commission revenue fell 3% (U.S. credit -9%) offset by record services revenue (+14%) and 6% growth in emerging-markets commissions. Expenses rose 1% (3% ex-notable items), and operating margin fell 80bp y/y to 41.1% (180bp ex-notable items). Diluted EPS was $1.93 (+1% y/y, $1.95 ex-notable items) as a 5.5% smaller diluted share count offset a 4% net-income decline. Cash fell to $245.8M on revolver paydowns and dividend payments versus year-end 2025. The same day, MarketAxess announced a definitive merger agreement to be acquired by Intercontinental Exchange (ICE); it withdrew its FY2026 annual guidance and medium-term financial targets and suspended its earnings conference call and monthly trading-volume press releases pending deal close.

drivers.explanation: Commission revenue fell 3% (U.S. credit -9%) offset by 14% growth in services revenue and 6% growth in emerging-markets commissions; prior-year quarter benefited from elevated event-driven volatility.

Expenses rose 1% (3% ex-notable items) on higher technology/communications and professional fees; other income swung to a $0.1M expense from $5.6M of income a year ago on lower interest income and higher interest expense.
Cash fell versus year-end 2025 mainly from paying down revolving-credit borrowings and quarterly dividends, plus a rise in net receivables from broker-dealers, partly offset by operating cash flow.
